test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A farmer borrowed ₹1,32,000 from a money lender to do cultivation in his field. The rate of interest is 12.5% p.a. compounded annually. At the end of two years, he cleared his loan by paying ₹1,07,062.50 and his scooter. The cost (in ₹) of the scooter is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal(P) = Rs. 132000

Rate of interest(r) = 12.5%

Time(t) = 2 years

He paid Rs. 107062.5 and his scooter

**Concept used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)t

**Calculation:**

12.5% = 1/8

So,

Amount = 132000 × 9/8 × 9/8

⇒ 167062.5

So,

Price of the scooter = 167062.5 - 107062.5 = 60000

**∴ The cost (in ₹) of the scooter is 60000**
